name: NieR:Automata
_run_note: The game reads XInput only: the DualSense needs Steam Input on. Turn the game's own vibration off. Hook = Wwise PostEvent in the running game (code is encrypted on disk), names from the public list bnnm/wwiser-utils (dll/nier/event_ids.json). Sounds = banks inside the game's archives (tools/wwise_bnk.py). Floor type arrives as a switch (SE_FloorCollisionType): its function is not hooked yet, so no ground texture.

struck._why: the names that mark my damage are voice grunts: the moment is right, the sound is not a vibration

hurt._why: the names that mark my damage are voice grunts: the moment is right, the sound is not a vibration

extra_rules._note: Wwise stop events carry the name of what they stop: never a vibration

_controls_note: Default pad layout (from general knowledge of the game, not read from this install): square = light attack, triangle = heavy attack, cross = jump, R1 = pod fire (held), L1 = pod program, R2 = evade, L2 = lock-on. Modes besides 3D action: side / top-down camera sections (same sounds), flight unit shooting (pl0010_*, core_stg_*), hacking twin-stick shooter (core_hak_*).

triggers._note: R2 = evade: nothing is held there, so only the perfect evade answers on the trigger (a short kick). First value, not felt.

source._note: tools/soundprep.py nier: banks found inside the user's own game archives (no key), events -> sounds read from the banks, names from the public list

cutscene._note: every cutscene posts ev####_Se (its whole effects bed) and ev####_Vo; many post ev####_End when over, and a movie closing posts se_movie_out (seen in the title's attract loop, 10-09). Otherwise the track ends when my own steps / attacks come back
